title: Quantitative Decision Analysis
design_goal: Top-university-caliber applied quantitative reasoning for autonomous decision-making, without credential imitation.
benchmark_basis: Stanford-style probability, estimation and applied uncertainty reasoning
MIT Sloan-style finance, valuation and managerial decision analysis
Top-university microeconomics, causal reasoning and data-analysis practice

default_submission_contract.numerical_rule: A derived quantity is incomplete without inputs, formula/model, units, and an independent verification path.
default_submission_contract.self_audit_rule: Every material assignment has Pass A: solve and Pass B: independently reconstruct, attack, and certify or revise. A wrong answer surviving self-audit is a critical cognitive failure.
default_submission_contract.tool_rule: Code may calculate and test; it may not replace an independently stated mathematical model or evidential interpretation.

modules.title: Quantitative Foundations
units: Use ratios, rates, percentages and percentage-point changes correctly.
Solve mixed business-rate problems with explicit units and reverse checks.
Rearrange formulas and solve multi-step equations without losing variable meaning.
Derive unknown price, volume, margin and break-even variables from constrained cases.
Use exponentials, logarithms, compounding and discounting correctly.
Reconcile annual, monthly and cohort growth/decay measures.
Detect unit, scale and magnitude errors before interpretation.
Audit a deliberately inconsistent model containing time-unit, currency and order-of-magnitude traps.

modules.title: Applied Financial Mathematics
units: Calculate present/future value, discounting and annuity-style cash flows.
Rebuild a discounted cash-flow schedule from raw cash events.
Calculate gross margin, contribution margin, CAC, LTV and payback with explicit definitions.
Compare acquisition channels using reconciled cohort economics.
Model burn, runway, working capital, break-even and financing needs.
Stress-test a venture cash plan under price, volume and cost shocks.
Use NPV, break-even and threshold analysis to support decisions.
Identify the exact assumptions at which a build/revise/kill recommendation reverses.

modules.title: Probability and Uncertainty
units: Separate joint, conditional and independent events.
Use expected value and variance for uncertain outcomes.
Compare projects with identical means but different downside distributions.
Update beliefs when new evidence arrives without confusing posterior belief with observed frequency.
Revise a demand thesis after sequential evidence batches.
Represent staged choices, probabilities and payoffs transparently.
Build and audit a launch/delay/kill decision tree.

modules.title: Statistics and Data Analysis
units: Use center, spread, quantiles and segmentation without hiding heterogeneity.
Diagnose an aggregated KPI dataset for misleading averages.
Reason about sampling error, confidence intervals and uncertainty.
Estimate uncertainty around conversion and retention metrics.
Interpret simple regression and correlation without causal overclaim.
Analyze a multivariable business dataset and state bounded conclusions.
Handle missing values, duplicates, outliers and inconsistent units.
Clean and document a deliberately corrupted commercial dataset before analysis.

modules.title: Causal and Evidential Reasoning
units: Distinguish descriptive association from causal evidence.
Critique causal claims in an observational growth report.
Detect selection, survivorship, measurement and omitted-variable bias.
Explain how a seemingly successful customer cohort can mislead.
Label every material claim as observed, calculated, estimated, assumed, inferred or forecast.
Convert an unlabeled investment memo into a traceable evidence-state ledger.
Design tests with metrics, counterfactual logic and stopping criteria.
Construct a demand experiment that can genuinely falsify the thesis.

modules.title: Applied Microeconomics
units: Translate price sensitivity into revenue and volume implications.
Model price changes across an elasticity range.
Use marginal cost, marginal benefit and opportunity cost in resource allocation.
Choose among capacity investments using incremental economics.
Analyze competition, entry barriers, substitutes and bargaining power.
Build a quantified market-structure assessment for a new entrant.
Anticipate customer, competitor and channel responses to policy or pricing changes.
Stress-test a strategy under competitor retaliation and substitution.

modules.title: Decision Analysis and Scenario Modeling
units: Measure which assumptions dominate a decision.
Rank model variables by decision sensitivity.
Build coherent base, upside and downside cases rather than independent arbitrary numbers.
Produce linked scenarios for demand, pricing, margin and cash.
Find the exact conditions under which a recommendation changes.
Calculate decision reversal points for CAC, churn, price and runway.
Decide when additional research is worth its cost.
Choose the next experiment based on expected decision value.

modules.title: Model Reconciliation
units: Maintain value, unit, period, state, source and confidence for every decision-critical variable.
Build a canonical ledger from four partially conflicting reports.
Identify conflicting values, formulas, periods and definitions before synthesis.
Locate every incompatible CAC, ACV, churn, margin and cash statement in a case pack.
Recalculate all downstream outputs when a controlling variable changes.
Change one canonical assumption and enumerate every affected result.
Resolve conflicts by source authority and evidence, never by averaging contradictions away.
Defend the final canonical model against adversarial challenges.

modules.title: Computational Analysis
units: Implement formulas in code while preserving independent mathematical statements.
Create a reproducible unit-economics notebook or equivalent artifact.
Transform raw tables into traceable analysis-ready data.
Build a deterministic cleaning and aggregation pipeline.
Use simulation to understand ranges and nonlinear risk.
Run a scenario simulation with transparent assumptions and bounded interpretation.
Automate invariant, unit and reconciliation checks.
Write tests that fail when canonical variables disagree across outputs.

modules.title: Integrated Decision Laboratory
units: Assess source quality, clean data and establish evidence states.
Produce the capstone data-quality report and evidence ledger.
Combine market, unit economics, cash, statistics and uncertainty into one coherent model.
Produce a fully traceable canonical decision model.
Independently reconstruct critical calculations and attack assumptions.
Audit the model without being told whether the first solution is correct.
Make a build/revise/kill decision and show how it changes under new assumptions.
Defend the recommendation, then recompute after three externally supplied assumption changes.

advanced_reasoning_target.purpose: Define the upper-bound mathematical reasoning capability QDA-601 is training toward. Benchmark families are used as capability references, not as memorization targets.

benchmark_ladder.expectation: Basic multi-step arithmetic and grade-school word-problem competence. Passing this level is necessary but not evidence of advanced quantitative mastery.
Rigorous multi-step algebra, number theory, geometry, combinatorics, probability and related mathematical reasoning with explicit intermediate justification.
Solve difficult problems where identifying the correct structure and decomposition is more important than routine calculation.
Sustain difficult reasoning across a durable problem tree, decompose when one-pass reasoning is insufficient, verify intermediate claims, reconcile contradictions and recover from failed attempts.
Transfer mathematical reasoning into finance, statistics, economics, optimization, uncertainty, causal analysis and data-driven decision work.

advanced_reasoning_target.governing_standard: Silas should be able to solve MATH/AIME-level problems independently, use Python intelligently for computation, detect and correct his own mistakes, and handle FrontierMath-style difficulty through autonomous decomposition rather than collapsing when a problem exceeds one reasoning pass.
advanced_reasoning_target.anti_memorization_rule: Benchmark-style problems are diagnostic and training instruments. Training must vary problem structure, values and domains so success reflects transferable reasoning rather than pattern memorization.
advanced_reasoning_target.milestone_definition: The target milestone is sustained high-level mathematical reasoning across a durable problem tree with autonomous error recovery, not merely a benchmark score.
